note: Tavern placement, 1 racial + 1 neutral per zone, picked by Claude from brief_ie.md on 2026-10-05.

suggestions.reason: Beside Black Crag, the greenskin capital of the Badlands, in a crowded corner of Death Pass.
Blood River Valley, where dwarf, human and greenskin lands meet on the road to the Border Princes.
Miragliano, the Tilean merchant city, with no smithy for 68.
Barak Varr, the dwarf sea port at the head of Blood River, where every race trades.
Castle Bastonne at the heart of the kingdom; the densest cluster in Bretonnia (crowd 4), so it loses little.
Carcassonne, the southern march where Bretonnia meets the Empire and the Border Princes, far from the racial tavern.
The Gunpowder Road near Nan-Li, a crowded stretch of Cathay's trade road (crowd 4).
Hanyu Port, where the Ivory Road meets the sea and Skaven and Cathayan lands touch.
Under Zharr-Naggrund, the Chaos Dwarf capital on the Plain of Zharr.
Ruin's End at the Mouth of Ruin, where Ogre and Chaos Dwarf traders cross; the Darklands duplicates 4 and 5 are left alone.
Nuln, the Empire's gun-forge city, in a crowded patch (crowd 4) with no smithy for 92.
Gorssel on the Marienburg road, the Old World's great free port, with no smithy for 50.
Karak Hirn, the dwarf hold of the Black Mountains. The zone has only 5 spots, so each tavern costs a lot of it.
Axe Bite Pass country between Bretonnia and the Empire, with dwarfs, wood elves and outlaws nearby.
Kislev city on the River Urskoy, the most crowded spot in the zone (crowd 5).
The River Lynsk crossing between Kislev and Ostland, a border road for both.
Itza, the first temple-city, in a crowded stretch of the River Qurveza (crowd 4).
Port Reaver, the colonists' port on the Isthmus coast, full of pirates and treasure hunters.
The Great Hall of Greasus, the Ogre trading capital on the Ivory Road.
The Bone Road, where Ogre, Chaos Dwarf and dwarf lands meet.
Karond Kar, the Dark Elf slave port of the Broken Lands.
The Twisted Glade on the Clawed Coast, a Vampire Coast foothold among the Dark Elves. The Naggarond duplicates 54 and 62 are left alone.
Khemri, the capital of the Land of the Dead.
Lashiek, the corsair city of Araby's coast, far from Khemri.
Graeling Moot, a Norscan gathering place, beside the Monolith of Borkill.
The Bay of Blades, where Norscan raiders and Kislevite traders meet.
Iron Storm near Bloodwind Keep in the Eastern Steppes, the Warriors of Chaos heartland.
The Palace of Princes in the Cold Mires, where Khorne, Slaanesh and Dark Elf lands meet, at the far west of the zone.
Grotrilex's Glare Lighthouse, a beacon for lost ships in Tzeentch's Southern Wastes.
The Ice Fire Plains, between Khorne's daemons and the Lizardmen of the Godless Crater.
Zlatlan, the temple-city of the Southern Jungles. Skaven hold more settlements, but the Southlands are Lizardmen land.
Dawn's Landing, the High Elf colony port of the far south.
Lothern, Ulthuan's great harbour and the elves' window on the world; no smithy for 102.
Saphery near the White Tower of Hoeth, which draws scholars of every race; a crowded spot (crowd 4).
Karak Azul, the southern dwarf hold, in a crowded cluster (crowd 4).
Oakenhammer on Black Water, where dwarf holds and Sylvania face each other.
